---
params:
  x: NULL
  title: "LAGO optimization report"
title: "`r params$title`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
x <- params$x
# lago_blocks() is the shared presentation formatter; the report renders from
# the same blocks as print.lago()/summary.lago() so the two can never drift.
# It is an internal helper, hence the triple-colon access.
blocks <- LAGOtrials:::lago_blocks(x)
# plot.lago() only draws a figure for 1- or 2-component interventions; for 3+
# components it emits no plot. Gate the plot heading and figure on the same
# capability so a 3+ component result does not get a dangling, empty
# "Confidence set plot" section. Mirror plot.lago()'s own component count,
# which comes from the stored labels (not ncol(cs)).
plot_components <- if (!is.null(x$display_components)) {
  x$display_components
} else {
  x$intervention_components
}
plottable_cs <- !is.null(x$cs) && length(plot_components) %in% 1:2
```

```{r inputs, results='asis', eval=!is.null(blocks$inputs)}
cat("## ", blocks$inputs$title, "\n\n", sep = "")
cat(paste0("- ", blocks$inputs$rows), sep = "\n")
```

## `r blocks$recommendation$title`

```{r recommendation}
rec_rows <- blocks$recommendation$rows
if (!is.null(rec_rows$component)) {
  knitr::kable(
    rec_rows,
    col.names = c("Component", "Value"),
    align = c("l", "r")
  )
} else {
  knitr::kable(
    rec_rows,
    col.names = "Value",
    align = "r"
  )
}
```

```{r model-heading, results='asis', eval=!is.null(x$model)}
cat("## Outcome model fit\n")
```

```{r model, eval=!is.null(x$model)}
# the fitted outcome model carried on the object, shown as its coefficient
# table (same as summary(x$model) in the console summary()).
knitr::kable(
  stats::coef(summary(x$model)),
  caption = "Outcome model coefficients"
)
```

```{r plot-heading, results='asis', eval=plottable_cs}
cat("## Confidence set plot\n")
```

```{r plot, eval=plottable_cs, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
plot(x)
```
